# ImiCall
> One-to-one browser voice calls without an account or phone number.

- [Product and FAQ](/about.html): how private invitations, local contacts and browser calls work.
- [Privacy](/privacy.html): storage, permissions, encrypted negotiation, optional push retention and limitations.

Contacts and invitation secrets stay in browser storage. The application does not record calls or persist chat messages. The server holds live routing and opt-in push subscriptions only in memory; push entries expire within 24 hours of renewal and disappear on restart. Push delivery is not guaranteed. Hosting/network metadata may exist outside application control. This is not an audited anonymity tool, telephone replacement or emergency calling service.

Very weak / 2G voice requests a 6 kbps codec target; transport overhead is additional and real-world connectivity is not guaranteed. Tiny messages exchanges short encrypted notes while both users keep the app open, without microphone permission or TURN. Notes expire from app memory after 90 seconds and clear locally when the panel closes. No durable offline mailbox is provided.
